fact: The Annuaire du commerce extérieur 2024 (edition covering 2024, July 2025) publishes external trade statistics compiled from the monthly customs declarations file supplied by the Burkina Faso customs services (customs declarations); it is the successor of the 2023 edition (June 2024).
title: Annuaire du commerce extérieur 2024
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD)
